note: Staged effect scenes (roadmap WP 4.4, L4; DECISIONS D804). Each is drawn by the JS game's own Effects.js in a fly-camera station of the level and by the Rust client's play::fx with ?fx=<name>, from the same data: tools/parity/effects-scenes.mjs. Cars sit on the road at s + speed x frame x dt, lat across, heading along the road plus yaw; a body at the last pose carries the flames. Each frame the bursts due run (sparksAt, smokeAt), then effects.update(dt, night, extras). Math.random is mulberry32(seed) for the frames on both sides.

scenes.name: pools
scenes.what: Headlight pools at blue hour: the player's (9 x 16 m, 10 m ahead), a rival's and an oncoming car's (7 x 12 m, 7.5 m ahead), all at the shared opacity 0.3 x night

scenes.name: skid-smoke
scenes.what: A second and a half of a hard skid at 12 m/s: rear-wheel marks and tyre smoke (dark at night), the pool ahead

scenes.name: skid-day
scenes.what: The same skid by day on Sierra's first zone, seen from above: the marks on grey asphalt, the smoke light (night 0, no pools)

scenes.name: sparks-flames
scenes.what: Nitro flames on the player and a rival, and three bursts of sparks (a wall scrape and two contacts) in flight

scenes.name: launch
scenes.what: A second of launch puffs behind the player on the grid, and smoke bursts by a crashed car
